# Miles Sound System import library (6.6g)

`lib/mss32.lib` is the import library swkotor2.exe links for mss32.dll: Miles 6.6g (December 2004). It is the release
import library of the Miles 6.6g reconstruction (TeamGizka MilesSDK), identical to the shipped SDK library.
The headers stay those of `Miles/6.5h/include`.
